channel.title: Data-Visualization Tool ("Where Did They Go?") :: CS Two Year Refactor
channel.description: Working draft for faculty review. This page describes a real institutional asset, not a hypothetical example — see Signature Applications for why the program prefers real assets over invented ones. What it is “Where Did They Go?” (repo: github.com/ksu-cs/development-project-ksds) is an active external project — Vue + JavaScript + D3.js frontend, Node.js backend, static JSON/GeoJSON data, MIT license, 12+ releases as of mid-2026. It’s a partnership between K-State CS and the Chapman Center for Rural Studies (History department), visualizing rural population migration in Kansas — county borders, rail/interstate infrastructure, Army Corps of Engineers lakes, town populations, hospitals, schools — with playback over time.
